Night session (Webull): SPY 737.89 (-0.28%), QQQ -0.11%; the pre-market recovered to about the close. The OVERNIGHT.md lean needs the night down 0.3% or more: just short, not applied.

Monday: SPY -1.30% open to close, -1.91% on the day, the low near the close after CNBC said Nvidia's board is not considering Huang's return; SMH -5.11%. VIX about 22.9 at Monday's close (Rio Times briefing; not confirmed on a second source); VIXY -1.8% this morning.

08:30: retail sales +0.2% m/m (consensus +0.2%), ex-autos +0.6% (0.4%), control +0.6% (0.4%; September revised to +0.1%), import prices +1.1% (0.7%), export prices +1.1% (0.5%) (Webull macro calendar). Hot spending and import prices argue for yields up, but TLT and SPY were flat in the first two minutes. Fed: Waller on payments 09:10, Hammack 09:30, Williams 14:25.

Overnight: futures were -0.1% to -0.45% early (Reuters, 05:23) and recovered to flat; KOSPI -1.4%, Hang Seng -0.3%, DAX -0.6% to -0.8%. 10Y about 5.14% (-0.7bp), DXY about 103.5, WTI about 88.7, Brent quoted 91.5 to 95 (sources disagree).

News of the day: HD reported (comps +2.2%, adjusted EPS 3.86 vs 3.84, GAAP 3.72, FY comps raised to about 1.4%, EPS growth about 2%) and trades -2.2%; Senator Warren calls for breaking up health conglomerates (UNH -2.7%); a software bug disrupted JPM and BAC customers (JPM -0.8%); Meta, Amazon and Google failed to stop China data-center curbs (08:01; META -0.9%); Nvidia set up an export-control oversight committee and warned chip buyers on compliance; 13Fs: Citadel added Marvell (+729%), Nvidia cut its Intel stake.

For an up day: chips bounce into NVDA, Monday's -1.9% after a -0.7% Friday, the night sold and the pre-market bought it back, the data say the consumer is fine. Against: the havens that held Monday are being sold now, hot import prices with a hike priced, the China data-center curbs on the platforms, and positioning ahead of NVDA tonight; the last three sessions' opens were the highs. Not one-sided: p_up 0.50.

Drop lights at Monday's close: breadth and rates (stretched is off: SPY -1.7% over five sessions). Theme model: all ten themes neutral (chips, internet, software, power, optical carry the BREADTH turn flag; health and consumer BREADTH_UP heat flags).
Gap-downs of 2% or more among the names we watch: UNH -2.7% (Warren), HD -2.2% (report day, no sniper by rule). rebound_scanner is retired; no rule trades them.

Dossiers: AMD and META not in play for the sniper today (AMD's bounce has no news of its own; META's own news this morning is the China curbs, a negative). NVDA reports tonight: no NVDA trade by rule, and no chip sniper on the read-through.

sniper.catalyst: Own news from the last day: HSBC upgrades Cisco to Buy (Benzinga via Alpaca, 06:31 ET) and DZ Bank raises it to Buy from Hold (dailytradealert's table; not seen on Benzinga). It is the third session after the report (record revenue +24%, FY27 raised, a margin squeeze, about eight target cuts and -6.4% on 11-13): sell-side pushback after a post-earnings selloff. CSCO 96.10 at 08:32 (+1.7%; the chips are +1.3%, so part of the gap is the sector), median target 128.5 (Webull, 18 of 28 buy or strong buy), -12% on the month. Against it: HSBC had already upgraded Cisco to Buy in May 2026, so it must have cut it in between (not found); CEO Chuck Robbins filed a notice of a proposed stock sale last night (20:01); NVDA tonight can swing AI-infrastructure names either way; upgrades on names outside our 25 add +0.88% open to close on day 0 and only +0.22% after 09:32 (SLOWDRIFT_WIDE.md). Shadow only (catalyst_open about 0.10 delta, the hero, rating_open two contracts near 0.45 delta); the entry needs CSCO at or above its open between 09:31 and 10:00.
sniper.wrong_if: CSCO is below its open at 10:00, or it gives back the gap to under Monday's close 94.52 before 11:00.

opportunities.why: Sniper (see sniper): HSBC upgrades Cisco to Buy (Benzinga 06:31) and DZ Bank Hold -> Buy (dailytradealert), the third session after a -6.4% post-earnings day with about eight target cuts; median target 128.5 against ~96; +1.7% pre-market.

zh.summary: 今早大盘基本平：标普 ETF 盘前 739.25，和昨天收盘差不多（昨天 -1.9%）。里面是分裂的：芯片在英伟达今晚财报前反弹（半导体 ETF +1.3%、AMD +1.8%、美满 +3.9%），前几天有人买的防守股反过来被卖（联合健康 -2.7%，因为参议员沃伦呼吁拆分医疗集团；礼来 -1.4%；家得宝财报后 -2.2%；沃尔玛 -1.2%）。08:30 的零售数据比预期热一点（扣掉汽车和汽油 +0.6%，预期 0.4%），进口价格也偏高，但出来后股债都没动。
zh.spy: 不下注，收在开盘价上方的概率给 50%。往上的理由：芯片反弹、连跌两天后的修复、消费数据不差；往下的理由：防守股在被卖、物价偏热而加息已经定价、平台公司的对华数据中心限制。真正的方向要等今晚英伟达财报。
zh.sniper: 思科看涨。汇丰今早把它上调到买入（另一家德国 DZ 银行也上调了）。思科上周财报收入创纪录，但因为利润率被压、一圈目标价下调，第二天跌了 6.4%；现在券商开始反过来唱多。盘前 +1.7%，离分析师目标中位数还有三成多。信心 0.3：汇丰五月已经上调过一次，中间怎么变的没查到；CEO 昨晚报备了要卖股票。10:00 如果在开盘价下方就算错。只记影子。
zh.rotation: 一个月看，钱在消费、医疗、必需消费；AI 硬件各环节（显卡、存储、光模块、电力）都在流出。但今早反过来：芯片反弹，防守股被卖。没有哪个主题在「转向」，今天没有主题过滤。
